name: Can you coordinate the installation of client-supplied fixtures?

mainEntity.name: Can you coordinate the installation of client-supplied fixtures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we can absolutely coordinate the installation of client-supplied fixtures. We understand that clients often have specific preferences and may source unique items for their projects. Our role involves ensuring these fixtures are compatible with the existing rough-ins and design plans, verifying their specifications, and coordinating with the appropriate trades for proper installation. We'll confirm dimensions, power requirements, plumbing connections, and any other relevant details to ensure a seamless integration into your project. Communication regarding these items is key to prevent any unforeseen issues or delays during the installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we coordinate the installation of client-supplied fixtures, ensuring compatibility and proper integration into the project.
